# Enter KiCad Python here
import time

print("=== Layer Function Test Start ===")

print("1. Select F.Cu")
pcb_select_layer("F.Cu")
time.sleep(0.5)

print("2. Select B.Adhesive")
pcb_select_layer("B.Adhesive")
time.sleep(0.5)

print("3. Select Edge.Cuts")
pcb_select_layer("Edge.Cuts")
time.sleep(0.5)

print("4. Read B.Adhesive visibility")
state = pcb_onoff_layer("B.Adhesive")
print("B.Adhesive visible =", state)
time.sleep(0.5)

print("5. B.Adhesive OFF")
pcb_onoff_layer("B.Adhesive", False)
time.sleep(0.5)

print("6. Read B.Adhesive visibility")
print("B.Adhesive visible =", pcb_onoff_layer("B.Adhesive"))
time.sleep(0.5)

print("7. B.Adhesive ON")
pcb_onoff_layer("B.Adhesive", True)
time.sleep(0.5)

print("8. Read B.Adhesive visibility")
print("B.Adhesive visible =", pcb_onoff_layer("B.Adhesive"))
time.sleep(0.5)

print("=== Layer Function Test End ===")

import time

print("=== Selection Filter Test Start ===")

# 현재 상태 출력
state = pcb_select_filter_state()
print("현재 상태:")
print(state)

# Tracks 선택
print("\n[TEST] Tracks ON")
pcb_select_filter("Tracks", True)
time.sleep(1)

print("Tracks =", pcb_select_filter("Tracks"))

# Tracks 해제
print("\n[TEST] Tracks OFF")
pcb_select_filter("Tracks", False)
time.sleep(1)

print("Tracks =", pcb_select_filter("Tracks"))

# Vias 선택
print("\n[TEST] Vias ON")
pcb_select_filter("Vias", True)
time.sleep(1)

# Vias 선택
print("\n[TEST] Vias ON")
pcb_select_filter("Vias", False)
time.sleep(1)


# Pads 선택
print("\n[TEST] Pads ON")
pcb_select_filter("Pads", True)
time.sleep(1)


# Pads 선택
print("\n[TEST] Pads ON")
pcb_select_filter("Pads", False)
time.sleep(1)



# 최종 상태
print("\n최종 상태:")
print(pcb_select_filter_state())

print("=== Selection Filter Test End ===")
